content: Cekcoengawh Jesu ing ce a hun ce cehta nawh Jordan long caqai Judah qam benna cet hy. Cawh thlang kqeng ing a ven pan law tlaih bai uhy, a sai khawi amyihna cekkhqi ce cawngpyi khqi hy.
Farasi thlang vangkhqi ce law unawh noek a dak naakna awi doet uhy, “Thlang ing zu ak thlak ham ak thym hly nu?” tina uhy.

content.text: “Mosi ing ikawk awi nu a na peek khqi?”

content: Cekkhqi ing, “Mosi ingtaw zu thlak thainaak caa qee nawh zu thlak thainaak pehy,” tina uhy.

content.text: “Na mik kawlung a hqam soeih a dawngawh cemyihna anaa awi a na qee mai ni.
Cehlai ak cyk caawh Khawsa ing pa ingkaw nu a na sai hy.
Ve akawngawh pa ing a nu ingkaw a pa ce cehta nawh a zu tu lawm saw;
pakhih ce pum pynoet na awm kawm nih,' tina hy. Cedawngawh pakkhih na am awm voel nih nawh, pumoet na awm hawh hy nih.
Cedawngawh Khawsa ing a tawm ce hawh taw thlanghqing ing koeh hqe seh,”

content: Ipkhui na ami awm awh, ve akawng ve a hubatkhqi ing doet tlaih bai uhy.

content.text: “U ingawm a zu ce thla nawh nuk chang ce a zu naak tlaih awhtaw a zu ak khanawh sam ak phaih ni.
Nu ingawm a va ma nawh thlak chang a va naak awhtaw anih awm sam ak phaih ni,”

content: Jesu ing a bi hamna naasen cakhqi ce law pyi khqi uhy, cehlai a hubatkhqi ing kaa nak khqi uhy.
Cehlai Jesu ing cece a huh awh, ak kaw am law nawh, a hubatkhqi venawh,

content.text: “Naasen cakhqi ce ka venna law pyi khqi lah unawh, koeh hqek khqi uh, kawtih khan qam taw vemyihna ak awm thlangkhqi aham na ni.
Awitak ka nik kqawn peek khqi, u awm Khawsa ram ce naasen ca myihna amak do taw ityk awh awm ak khuina am lut tikaw,”

content: Naasenkhqi ce lo nawh ak pawn coengawh, a mingmih ak khan awh a kut tloeng nawh zoseennaak pek khqi hy.
Lam na a ceh awh, thlang pynoet ce a venna dawng law nawh a haiawh khuk sym doena, “Cawngpyikung leek, kumqui hqingnaak ka huhnaak thai ham ikaw ka sai hly?” tina hy.

content.text: “Ikawtih 'leek hy' tinawh na nik khy? Khawsa doeng tikaa taw u awm am leek hy.
Awipeekkhqi sim tik sawkaw: 'Thlang koeh him, koeh samphaih, koeh qu, amak thym dyihthing na koeh dyi, thlang koeh qaai na, na nu ingkaw na pa kqihchah lah,' a tice,”

content: Anih ing, “Cawngpyikung, vekkhqi boeih ve ka naasen awhkawng ni ka sai hawh hy,” tina hy.
Jesu ing anih ce toek nawh lungna soeih nawh,

content.text: “Ik-oeih pynoet voet hyn hy,”
“Cet nawh na kawhthemkhqi boeih ce zawi nawh khawdeng hahqahkhqi ce pe, cawhtaw khawk khanna qo ta kawp ti; cekcoengawh law nawh ka hu awh bat law,”

content: Cehlai a hai ta malh nawh, ik-oeih khawzah a taak a dawngawh kawseet doena valh tlaih hy.
Jesu ing hawi ang mang nawh, a hubatkhqi venawh

content.text: “Bawikhqi ing Khawsa ram awh a luhnaak aham kyi soeih mah hy!”

content: Ak awih kqawnnaak awh a hubatkhqi taw aming ngaih na kyi hy. Cehlai Jesu ing,

content.text: “Naasenkhqi, boei ak ypnaak thlangkhqi ham Khawsa qam khuiawh lut ve kyi soeih mah hy.
Bawi ak thlang ing Khawsa ram khuiawh a lut anglakawh Kalauk ing kqym ak khuiawh a lut zoei bet hy,”

content: A hubatkhqi ce amik kawpoek kyi khqoet nawh, “Cawhtaw u nu hul na ak awm hly hy voei?” ti uhy.
Jesu ing a mingmih ce toek khqi nawh, “

content.text: Thlanghqing aham taw am coeng thai hy, cehlai Khawsa ham taw ik-oeih boeih boeih ve coeng thai hy,”

content: Piter ing, “Kaimih ing ik-oeih boeih boeih cehta unawh na hu ka ming bat law ve!” tinawh doet hy.

content.text: “Awitak ka nik kqawn peek khqi, u ingawm kai ingkaw awithang leek ak caming a im a lo, a koeinaa, a koeinanu, a nu apa, a canaakhqi ingkaw a lokhqi a cehtaak awhtaw

tuh a khuk qoe awh a pyh zakhat dyna (imkhqi, a koeinaakhqi, a koeinukhqi, a nu a pakhqi, a canaakhqi ingkaw a lokhqi - cekkhqi ingkaw thekhanaakkhqi) ingkaw ak law hly a khuk awh, kumqui hqingnaak ce hu kaw.
Cehlai ak maakhqi ce huu khyng kawm usaw huu ak khyngkhqi ce maa lat kawm uh,”

content: A Thihnaak Hly Kawng Kqawn Bai Hy

Jerusalem benna ami hang ceh awh, Jesu taw a mingmih a haiawh lamma na cet hy, cawh a hubatkhqi taw amik kawpoek kyi hy. Thlanghqa hlaihih tloek ce ak chang na cehpyi nawh ak khan awh ik-oeih ak pha law hly ce kqawn pek khqi hy.

content.text: “Tuh Jerusalem na ni hang cet kawm usaw, thlanghqing Capa ve khawsawih boeikhqi ingkaw anaa awi cawngpyikungkhqi kut awh peekna awm kaw. A mingmih ing thih hamna ak khanawh awi tluuk sak kawm usaw Gentelkhqi kut awh pe kawm uh,
Cekkhqi ing anih ce the a kha na kawm usaw him kawm uh. Cehlai am thum nyn awh tho tlaih kaw,”

content: Zebedi a caqawi, Jakob ingkaw Johan ce a venna law hy nih. Cekkqawi ing, “Cawngpyikung, ka ni thoeh law a hoei boeih ve na sai hamna ngaih hlai nih nyng,” tina hy nih.

content.text: “Ikaw sai sak ham nu nani ngaih?”

content: Cekkqawi ing, “Na boeimangnaak khuina na awm awh pynoet tang benna pynoet cawng benna na ning ngawih sak qawi aham ngaih nih nyng,” tina hy nih.

content.text: “Ik-oeih nani thoeh ve am sim hy nik ti. Ka aawk hly kawi boet ve nami aw hly thai nawh nu? Baptisma ka huh hly kawi ve nani hu hly thai nawh nu?

content: Cekkqawi ing, “Oeih, hu thai lawt kawng nih nyng,” tina hy nih. Jesu ing,

content.text: “Kai ing ka aawk hly kawi boet ce aw thai kawm nih tiksaw ka huh hly kawi baptisma awm hu thai kawm nik ti,
Cehlai kak tang ben ingkaw kak cawng benawh ngawih thainaak taw kai ak cam amni, a hoep peek ak thlangkhqi ham ni,”

content: Ce ak awi ce thlanghqa tloek ing aming zaak awh Jakob ingkaw Johan ak khan awh amik kaw am law hy.
Jesu ing a mingmih ce kutoet na khy khqi nawh,

content.text: “Gentel ukkungkhqi ing a mimah Gentelkhqi ak khan awh boeina ami awm ce sim u hyk ti, dyih hun ak sang na ak awmkhqi ing a mingmih ce a ngaihnaak a myihna uk uhy.
Cehlai nangmih taw cemyihna am awm kawm uk ti. Nangmih anglakawh u ingawm ak bau khyt na awm a ngaih awhtaw nangmih a tyihzoeih na awm seh.
U awm lamma na awm ak ngaih ingtaw nangmih boeih a tamnaa na awm seh.
Ikawtih thlanghqing Capa ing za thlang bibi sak aham am law nawh, thlang a bi ak bi ham ni a law, thlang khawzah hulnaak aham a hqingnaak ak pe aham nani a law,”

content: Cekcoengawh Jeriko khaw na ce pha uhy. Jesu ing a hubatkhqi, thlang kqeng mi khawk bau awhkawng ami ceh hui awh, mikhyp pynoet, Timai a capa, Bertimai ak mingnaak, taw lam keng awh ngawi nawh a kut dun hy.
Nazareth khaw awhkaw Jesu ni ak cet tice ang zaak awh, “David Capa, Jesu, kai nim qeen lah!” tinawh khy hy.
Thlangkhqi ing awm dym aham zyi uhy, cehlai anih ing,, “David Capa kai nim qeen lah!” tinawh khy hy.

content.text: Anih ce khy lah uh,”

content: tinak khqi hy. Cedawngawh cawhkaw mikhyp ce khy uhy, “Nang ngaih qep sak nawh dyi lah, nik khy nyng,” tina hy.
Anih ing a hi ce khawng nawh ang peh doena Jesu a venna cet hy.

content.text: “Nak khanawh ikaw sai pek ham na ngaih?”

content: tina hy. Cawh, mikhyp ing a venawh, “Rabboni, huh thai ngaih hy nyng,” tina hy.

content.text: Cet hlah, nak cangnaak ing ni qoei sak hawh hy,”

content: tina hy. Bawtbet awh amik ce dai nawh Jesu a hu awh bat pahoei hy.
